title: Beethoven — Für Elise, WoO 59 (Mutopia typeset)

reference.license: Public Domain (Mutopia 2015/08/18-931, Stelios Samelis after Breitkopf & Härtel 1888). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: Same musical text as the `fur-elise` pin, but the PDF is the Mutopia LilyPond typeset at reference.url's sibling — so PDF, MIDI and .ly all come from one source and the whole entry is fetchable. `fur-elise` keeps the IMSLP scan for the hosted-vs-local shootout; do not cross the two.
LilyPond \tempo 4 = 72 under a transparent MetronomeMark; the printed heading is 'Poco moto.' in 3/8 with a one-eighth pickup (pickupQuarters 0.5).

The first \repeat volta 2 borrows an eighth across the barline: its first ending is `a'4` over `a,16 e a r`, a printed 2/8 bar (partialBars bar 8), completed by the one-eighth anacrusis when the repeat is retaken; the second ending spends the same eighth on the far side of a `\bar ""`, which draws nothing, so the page shows one full 3/8 bar there. The second \repeat volta 2's endings are both full 3/8 — the borrow happens exactly once.

Because of that borrow the reference MIDI, which is written straight through (repeats not taken), runs one eighth out of phase with the engraved barlines from bar 9 on. partialBars puts the reference notes back in the bars the page draws; without it every bar after the first ending pairs two thirds of the right notes at the wrong onsets. Both bar pins are therefore the ENGRAVED counts: printedBars 106 (pickup as bar 0) and performedBars 127, surplus 21 (repeat 1 surplus 8, repeat 2 surplus 13). Keep the two in one convention — do not move one without the other.

performedBars 127 is derived from the Mutopia .ly at https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BeethovenLv/WoO59/fur_Elise_WoO59/fur_Elise_WoO59.ly (sha256 828a7bd1b42e441fe1b0eb0389ba46f1502dab28bbe488389e635fb446ba7a67); the folded render reproduces the pinned reference MIDI byte-for-byte (905 notes). The retake of repeat 1 replays the anacrusis, which is what makes its 2/8 first ending a whole bar; the printed page is 106 bars and the performance is 127.

No ornament signs (the \grace and \appoggiatura figures are ordinary notes in the reference MIDI), so expectedExtraNotes is 0.
